scope: Failure-only D91 image admission/lifetime/refresh and renderer diagnostics; no reaper or resource-policy changes
counter_scope: Existing ACTIVE calls require the single GL-owner thread and reference contract. Atomic cumulative counters saturate atUINT32_MAX; bounded current counts track allocated objects/pending submissions/quarantine retained by the unchanged destructor. Charged slots also include allocation reservations. Cross-counter snapshots are observational, not transactional. No registry or reclaim is introduced.
limitations: Current live counters cover only objects created through the instrumented create path, not externally constructed test objects.
Header records Vulkan result at the existing failing call; nonVulkan results are tagged vk_result_valid=false.
D91 quarantine still retains backing until process exit and may lose its caller pointer; diagnostics do not reclaim it.
Renderer read/import failures can invalidate the compositor context; diagnostic logging does not recover presentation.
Failure record caps are independent per translation unit and remain finite; later failures after those caps are not individually logged.

counter_definitions.charged: Original quota counter; includes allocation reservations and retained quarantine.
counter_definitions.active: Allocated instrumented objects not classified as quarantined; includes constructors in progress.
counter_definitions.pending: Instrumented pending flags, cleared only when existing code observes completion or disposes the object; not a fresh measurement of GPU execution.
counter_definitions.quarantined: Objects retained by existing D91 pending-destroy behavior; no registry or retry is introduced.
counter_definitions.allocated: Successful C object allocations, including later failed constructors.
counter_definitions.created: Constructors returning a complete bridge object.
counter_definitions.freed: Instrumented C object disposals, including failed constructors.
counter_definitions.conservation: On the existing serialized caller path before cumulative saturation: allocated = active + quarantined + freed. Cross-counter snapshots are not transactions.

host_validation.scope: Actual patched bridge C plus extracted actual renderer diagnostic/resource-read helper, mocked GPU/EGL/context calls and real owned Linux descriptors. Missing-EGL and texture-import integration checked in exact source; full renderer compilation is not covered by this fixture; separate candidate build/ABI proof is recorded below.
host_validation.intentional_quarantine: Fixture keeps LeakSanitizer roots only, with no read/retry/reclaim after destroy. Retained FDs and pending backing are asserted; this is not a leak-free or reclamation claim.

build_scope: Offline renderer ELF only; no worker/image assembly, installation or physical runtime qualification
runtime_scope: Original guest boots; actual active-slot refusal and missing-EGL telemetry observed; diagnostics do not repair stale presentation
